summary: Brightens the fixed layer with the screened overlay layer, where black overlay pixels behave transparent and white overlay pixels become white.

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Fixed Layer selection: Input 1 or Input 2.

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Overlay extend behavior at image edges.

key_params.name: legacyxform
key_params.note: Use the legacy transform matrix behavior.

common_gotchas: Screen is not alpha-over; it is a brightening blend where black overlay pixels have no visible effect.
Changing Fixed Layer changes final resolution/aspect and transform target, not the compositing order.
Use Native Resolution prefit for pixel-accurate overlays.
Legacy Transform changes rotation and transform-order behavior.
key_concepts: Screen compositing brightens the underlying layer based on the screened layer brightness; black overlay pixels behave transparent and white pixels become white.
Fixed Layer selects which input defines output resolution and aspect without changing the Screen input order.
Transform parameters affect only the overlay layer, not the fixed layer.
The operator supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
